creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From the window board on the Lectern page muster-ui-redesign: each pane gets a header with its chord, state icon, callsign, name, directory, state word and time held, and context bar. Blocked and stuck headers are tinted, as the agent list's rows are.

A split then says which agent is which without the sidebar. With the state in the header, the border around a pane marks only the pane the keyboard reaches, and the state-colored border goes. docs/architecture.md describes that border legend and changes with it.
title: Pane headers carry chord, state and directory; the border marks only focus
